headline: Sox Eye Sweep After Bullpen Shuts Down Rangers At Fenway
morning_brew: That is what I am talking about, two wins in a row against the Rangers and we are suddenly looking at a sweep opportunity tonight. Ranger Suarez gave us five solid innings with seven strikeouts, keeping things steady before the bullpen took over. Garrett Whitlock came in and did his job to lock down the win, and Aroldis Chapman shut the door in the ninth for the save. It was beautiful to watch, especially after that brutal stretch we just endured. If this team can keep playing with this kind of spark, we might actually turn this season around.

The bats kept the line moving with eleven hits, showing some real grit. Ceddanne Rafaela came through with two huge runs batted in, and Willson Contreras collected two hits to keep the pressure on Texas. My mother called me after the final out and said she hasn't seen the boys run the bases with this much energy since April. She is absolutely right, because they looked like a completely different team out there. We did commit one error, but the defense held when it mattered and did not let the game slip away.

Down in Foxborough, there is a bit of contract drama with rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas missing minicamp. He is the only second-round draft pick in the entire league who has not signed yet, and frankly, we need a guy who wants to be here. The front office needs to get this kid signed and on the field before training camp starts.

news_digest.headline: Why was Patriots rookie Gabe Jacas absent from minicamp?
news_digest.dans_take: Get the pen out and sign the kid already, we need him in camp.
